VinGrade.

Grading, with evidence.

Essay scores need a reason. VinGrade connects rubric-based assessment to evidence in the essay, with a review flow for teachers.

Role
AI & backend development
Built with
Python · FastAPI · pgvector · React

The problem

What needed to work.

Make AI-assisted assessment inspectable: a teacher should be able to understand the evidence behind a score and review the result.

The workflow

A deliberate path.

  1. Assess

    Evaluate the essay against assignment-specific rubric criteria.

  2. Ground

    Attach quoted essay evidence to the assessment.

  3. Review

    Let a teacher inspect and review the grading output.

My contribution

Under the interface.

  • Rubric-based grading and evidence validation.
  • JWT-secured FastAPI endpoints for classes, assignments and rubrics.
  • Similarity-based duplicate flags for human review.
  • LLM tracing, token usage visibility and regression checks.

Engineering decisions

Evidence before confidence

Scores are accompanied by essay evidence so the teacher can inspect the reasoning.

A reviewable workflow

AI assists the assessment; teachers remain responsible for reviewing the result.

Project context

Built during the Vingroup × VinUni Applied AI Talent Program. The screenshot shows the English landing page from a local build. Repository access is private; no public live demo is linked.
